title: Urine drug test
what: You give urine in a container. The test shows whether drugs or some strong medicines have been in your body.
why: For certificates for work, a gun license, or a driver's license; at an employer's request; or for medical checkups.
duration: collecting takes 5 to 10 minutes; a rapid result comes in a few minutes; a confirming lab test usually takes a few days
tell_doctor: All medicines you take, even common cough medicines or painkillers
If you recently had anesthesia or strong painkillers

prepare.title: ID
prepare.text: Bring your ID. Without it, the test for a certificate is usually not accepted.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Write down what you take and tell the nurse.

prepare.title: Drinking
prepare.text: Drink as usual. Do not drink extra water. Urine that is too diluted may be rejected.

bring: Your referral or request from work
steps: Your ID is checked, and you get a labeled container
Before going to the toilet, you may be asked to leave your bag and coat
You pee into the container, sometimes while observed. The rules require it
The container is closed and sealed in front of you
The test is done right away or sent to the lab
feel: Nothing unpleasant, though being observed may feel awkward
after: The rapid result is usually ready right away
If the rapid test is positive, the urine is checked with a precise lab method
The certificate is issued within the time they tell you

faq.q: Can a regular medicine make the test positive?
faq.a: Yes, some medicines affect the rapid test. That is why you should name them. Unclear cases are checked with a precise method.

faq.q: Why is urine collected while observed?
faq.a: It is a rule for certificates, to make sure the sample is not swapped. It is the same for everyone.

reminders.text: Drug test tomorrow. Bring your ID and a list of your medicines.
